question: Should Comfy `workflowPath` reject all existing workflow files above a fixed 16 MiB limit, and if so what upgrade contract should users receive?
rationale: The streaming implementation is mechanically narrow, but the permitted workflow-file size is a product compatibility policy that the code and tests cannot determine.

options.title: Set an explicit compatible limit
options.body: Choose and document a justified maximum, then add fresh-install and upgrade coverage for valid existing workflow paths near that boundary.

options.title: Use a less disruptive bound
options.body: Retain bounded reading while selecting a higher or otherwise compatible safety limit that avoids rejecting known supported Comfy workflows.

options.title: Defer the hard cap
options.body: Keep this PR paused until maintainers decide whether a fixed workflow-file maximum belongs in the bundled Comfy contract.

recommendation.title: Set an explicit compatible limit
recommendation.body: Choose and document a justified maximum, then add fresh-install and upgrade coverage for valid existing workflow paths near that boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor on the exact proposed boundary and can clarify the intended limit, while acceptance still requires maintainer product judgment.
